segments.name: Rare diseases
segments.description: Develops and commercializes therapies for patients with rare diseases, led by IMCIVREE for rare obesity and hyperphagia caused by genetic pathway disorders.
segments.evidence: The Company currently operates in two business segments, which are U.S. and international segments for the development and commercialization of therapies for patients with rare diseases.

revenueModel.text: Specialty pharmacy and international customers pay for IMCIVREE, our approved therapy for patients with rare genetic diseases causing severe obesity and hyperphagia.
revenueModel.evidence: In the United States, which accounts for the largest portion of our total revenues, the Company sells its product through a specialty pharmacy.
